en: Tinted blue-and-white view of a large two‑storey historic building with a central pointed-arch doorway and Gothic windows, set behind a garden. Printed greeting text appears at top right and a caption under the image identifies the building as a Protestant church seminary. Publisher and printer credits run vertically along the left edge. The reverse shows the Hungarian word for postcard, "Levelező‑lap.", with dotted address lines.
